cases.case_label: Hybrid SVA_C/E in TCOF1 intron 17 (Treacher Collins syndrome, mosaic father)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 3,396-bp hybrid SVA_C/SVA_E deep in TCOF1 intron 17 (just downstream of the minor isoform c) is partially exonized (~750 bp of SVA included with a frameshift/stop, NMD) and shifts the allele toward the short non-canonical isoform c, reducing canonical TCOF1. Two paternal half-siblings inherited it from their unaffected gonadosomatic mosaic father.
cases.quote: In both cycloheximide-treated and untreated cells, we detected the expression and incorporation of ∼750 bp of the SVA C together with TCOF1 exons (Figure 2B), in correspondence to the sites predicted by SpliceAI (Figure 3A), confirming the SVA exonization, already described for other pathogenic SVA insertions.
